description: Romano-British farmstead, the earliest activity is dated to the later 2nd CE, the latest evidence is iron smelting in the 4th CE. A small timber structure was identified as a possible shrine, it included a central post hole with a complete pot placed inside. Dating of the structure is uncertain.
